metadata.name: guidance
metadata.description: Answer user questions about QwenPaw installation and configuration: first locate and read local documentation, then distill the answer; if local information is insufficient, fall back to the official website documentation.

metadata.name: QA_source_index
metadata.description: Maps topics and keywords from user questions to QwenPaw official documentation paths and common source code entry points, reducing blind searching. Intended for the built-in QA Agent to quickly identify which files to read when answering questions about installation, configuration, skills, MCP, multi-agent, memory, CLI, etc.
